description: Authoritative DISA STIG and SRG Baseline Checklist Catalog for Cloud Enclave Authorization

cloud_computing_srg.title: DISA Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (CC SRG)
cloud_computing_srg.scope: Mission Owner responsibilities for cloud enclaves, Assured Workloads IL5 guardrails, organization policies, and FedRAMP inheritance.
cloud_computing_srg.action: Complete Cloud Computing Mission Owner CKL; verify Assured Workloads boundary guardrails and organization policy constraints.

identity_and_access_management_iam_srg.title: DISA Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) SRG / IAM STIG
identity_and_access_management_iam_srg.scope: Cloud Identity SAML/OIDC federated SSO, hardware MFA enforcement, custom IAM roles, and automated service account key rotation.
identity_and_access_management_iam_srg.action: Complete IAM CKL; audit all custom role bindings, eliminate static service account keys in favor of Workload Identity Federation.

key_and_certificate_management_srg.title: DISA Key and Certificate Management SRG / KMS STIG
key_and_certificate_management_srg.scope: FIPS 140-3 Cloud KMS CMEK encryption keys, 90-day automated key rotation, Certificate Manager TLS 1.3 PKI, and algorithm restrictions.
key_and_certificate_management_srg.action: Complete Key Mgmt CKL; verify CMEK association across all storage buckets, disks, and databases with automatic rotation active.

canonical_ubuntu_2204_lts.title: DISA Canonical Ubuntu 22.04 LTS STIG
canonical_ubuntu_2204_lts.scope: Hardened Ubuntu Linux Compute Engine instances and build worker bastions.
canonical_ubuntu_2204_lts.action: Complete Ubuntu 22.04 CKL; apply Ubuntu Security Guide (USG) DISA profile in STIG Viewer desktop app.

canonical_ubuntu_2004_lts.title: DISA Canonical Ubuntu 20.04 LTS STIG
canonical_ubuntu_2004_lts.action: Complete Ubuntu 20.04 CKL in STIG Viewer desktop app.

canonical_ubuntu_2404_lts.title: DISA Canonical Ubuntu 24.04 LTS STIG
canonical_ubuntu_2404_lts.scope: Hardened Ubuntu 24.04 LTS host compute instances.
canonical_ubuntu_2404_lts.action: Complete Ubuntu 24.04 CKL; apply DISA profile in STIG Viewer.

red_hat_enterprise_linux_9.title: DISA Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8/9 STIG
red_hat_enterprise_linux_9.scope: Hardened Compute Engine VM hosts and administrative bastions.
red_hat_enterprise_linux_9.action: Complete RHEL / Linux OS CKL; apply OpenSCAP/Ansible DISA STIG baseline.

debian_linux.title: DISA Debian Linux STIG / General Purpose OS SRG
debian_linux.scope: Hardened Debian Linux Compute Engine host instances.
debian_linux.action: Complete Debian OS CKL; apply Debian security hardening baseline.

ms_windows_server_2019.title: DISA Microsoft Windows Server 2019/2022 STIG
ms_windows_server_2019.scope: Hardened Windows Server Compute Engine instances and active directory bastions.
ms_windows_server_2019.action: Complete Windows Server CKL; apply DISA GPO baseline in STIG Viewer desktop app.

suse_linux_enterprise_server.title: DISA SUSE Linux Enterprise Server STIG
suse_linux_enterprise_server.action: Complete SLES CKL; apply OpenSCAP baseline.

cisco_ios_xe_router.title: DISA Cisco IOS-XE Router STIG / Network Infrastructure SRG
cisco_ios_xe_router.scope: Virtual edge router instances, IPsec transport encryption, and perimeter routing appliances.
cisco_ios_xe_router.action: Complete Cisco IOS-XE Router CKL; verify MACsec / IPsec encryption and control plane policing.

kubernetes.title: DISA Kubernetes STIG & Container Platform SRG
kubernetes.scope: GKE private clusters, master control plane endpoints, RBAC, and Container Platform security.
kubernetes.action: Complete Kubernetes CKL; audit master authorized networks and Pod Security Standards in STIG Viewer.

container_platform_srg.title: DISA Container Platform & Serverless Workload SRG
container_platform_srg.scope: Serverless container workloads, Cloud Run service perimeters, and stateless compute isolation.
container_platform_srg.action: Complete Container Platform CKL; enforce VPC-SC perimeter on Cloud Run services and verify non-root container execution.

docker_enterprise.title: DISA Container Runtime & Docker Enterprise STIG
docker_enterprise.scope: Container base images, Dockerfile hardening, and non-root execution.
docker_enterprise.action: Complete Docker Enterprise CKL; eliminate root user in Dockerfiles and verify artifact signing.

postgresql_13.title: DISA PostgreSQL 13/14/15/16 STIG
postgresql_13.scope: Cloud SQL PostgreSQL / AlloyDB instances, PGAudit logging, and TLS in transit.
postgresql_13.action: Complete PostgreSQL CKL; configure PGAudit database flags and verify Cloud Logging sink.

oracle_mysql_8.0.title: DISA Oracle MySQL 8.0 STIG
oracle_mysql_8.0.scope: Cloud SQL MySQL database instances and secure transport enforcement.
oracle_mysql_8.0.action: Complete MySQL CKL; enforce require_secure_transport and audit logging.

ms_sql_server_2016_instance.title: DISA Microsoft SQL Server 2016/2019 STIG
ms_sql_server_2016_instance.scope: Cloud SQL SQL Server / MSSQL database instances.
ms_sql_server_2016_instance.action: Complete SQL Server CKL; configure Windows Authentication / Cloud IAM and TLS encryption.

oracle_database_12c.title: DISA Oracle Database 12c/19c STIG
oracle_database_12c.scope: Oracle database instances and Transparent Data Encryption (TDE).
oracle_database_12c.action: Complete Oracle CKL; enforce unified auditing and secure connection strings.

database_srg.title: DISA Database Security Requirements Guide (Generic RDBMS SRG)
database_srg.scope: Managed relational database services, CMEK encryption at rest, and private IP only.
database_srg.action: Complete Database SRG CKL; enforce require_ssl=true and disable public IPv4.

mongodb_enterprise_3.x.title: DISA MongoDB Enterprise STIG / NoSQL Database SRG
mongodb_enterprise_3.x.scope: Document database instances, wiredTiger encryption, and SCRAM authentication.
mongodb_enterprise_3.x.action: Complete MongoDB CKL; enforce role-based access control and TLS transport.

storage_area_network_san_srg.title: DISA Storage Area Network (SAN) / Cloud Object Store SRG
storage_area_network_san_srg.scope: Google Cloud Storage (GCS) buckets, uniform bucket access, and retention policy locks.
storage_area_network_san_srg.action: Complete Storage SRG CKL; verify public access prevention and CMEK key encryption.

firewall_srg.title: DISA Perimeter Firewall & Network Infrastructure SRG
firewall_srg.scope: VPC Hub/Spoke perimeter firewall policy tiers, default-deny ingress, and Cloud IAP bastions.
firewall_srg.action: Complete Firewall CKL; verify default-deny ingress rule and zero 0.0.0.0/0 exposure.

vpn_gateway_srg.title: DISA Virtual Private Network (VPN) Gateway SRG
vpn_gateway_srg.scope: Cloud HA VPN gateways, IPsec cryptographic profiles, and BGP dynamic routing.
vpn_gateway_srg.action: Complete VPN Gateway CKL; enforce IKEv2 and AES-GCM 256-bit encryption cipher suites.

web_application_firewall_srg.title: DISA Web Application Firewall (WAF) SRG
web_application_firewall_srg.scope: Cloud Armor WAF policies, adaptive protection against DDoS, and OWASP Top 10 rule sets.
web_application_firewall_srg.action: Complete WAF SRG CKL; verify pre-configured OWASP CRS rules and rate-limiting policies.

application_security_and_development_sti.title: DISA Application Security and Development (ASD) STIG
application_security_and_development_sti.scope: DevSecOps CI/CD pipelines, container vulnerability scanning, and OWASP defenses.
application_security_and_development_sti.action: Complete ASD STIG CKL; incorporate automated container scanning in CI/CD pipeline.

apache_server_2.4_unix_server.title: DISA Apache / Nginx Web Server STIG
apache_server_2.4_unix_server.scope: Web servers, reverse proxies, and Target HTTP/HTTPS proxies.
apache_server_2.4_unix_server.action: Complete Web Server CKL; disable weak TLS ciphers, server tokens, and enforce HTTP security headers.

enterprise_message_broker_srg.title: DISA Enterprise Message Broker & Telemetry Ingestion SRG
enterprise_message_broker_srg.scope: Cloud Pub/Sub messaging topics, telemetry pipelines, and dead-letter queues.
enterprise_message_broker_srg.action: Complete Message Broker CKL; enforce CMEK encryption on topics and restrict publisher/subscriber IAM roles.
